f1.quote: High-energy ball milling (HEBM) in an argon atmosphere for 1-6 hours

f2.quote: Spark Plasma Sintering (SPS) in a vacuum environment at 900-1000°C for 10 minutes.

f3.quote: Milling at 400 rpm with a 20:1 ball-to-powder weight ratio

f4.quote: SPS heating rate of 50°C/min, holding time 10 min, mold diameter 30.4 mm.

f5.quote: Prolonged milling induces severe lattice strain and crystal size reduction (<48 nm), promoting a non-equilibrium nanocrystalline solid solution

f6.quote: SPS accelerates diffusion and densification while suppressing porosity

f7.quote: stabilizing a mixed 83% FCC / 17% BCC phase structure.

f8.quote: Hardness and strength enhancement arise from the synergistic combination of grain boundary strengthening (Hall-Petch) due to nanocrystalline grain sizes, dislocation density accumulation from milling, and solid solution strengthening

f9.quote: A bulk alloy with density >6.5 g/cm³, Vickers hardness of ~675 Hv, and compressive strength of ~1894 MPa... relative to Cast CoCrFeNiTi alloys which suffer from porosity, heterogeneous microstructure, and significantly lower hardness/strength.
